description.p: Polo is a lightweight Markdown viewer built in Rust and GTK4. It opens a document and renders it — nothing else. There is no editor, so it starts quickly and stays out of the way when you want to read rather than write.

Rendering is identical to the preview in Marco, the companion editor, because both use the same parser. A document looks the same whichever one opens it, including the syntax extensions aimed at technical writing.
Polo works on its own and does not require Marco. If Marco is installed, Polo can hand the open document straight to it for editing.

ul.li: Fast, read-only rendering with no editing surface to get in the way
Full CommonMark support, plus Marco's syntax extensions
Contents panel for navigating long documents
File browser for moving between documents in a folder
Multiple preview themes, light and dark
Follows the system light and dark colour scheme
Hands the open document to Marco for editing, when Marco is installed

screenshot.caption: The contents panel open for navigating a long document

description.p: Local link and image paths now resolve against the document, and the preview follows the system colour scheme live. Polo now ships as its own application rather than alongside the editor.
